text: What if you stacked a trillion dollars?
A trillion is a million millions.
Use hundreds. Each one is a tenth of a millimeter.
A million dollars? A stack about waist high.
A billion? Over a kilometer, into the clouds.
Now stack a thousand of those billions.
Ten billion bills shoot past the airliners...
past the edge of space at a hundred kilometers...
past the space station at four hundred!
It stops at about eleven hundred kilometers.
Two and a half times higher than the station!
And it weighs ten thousand tons.
About as heavy as the Eiffel Tower!
That takes over three hundred years.
In one-dollar bills? A hundred times taller!
So... would you climb it for the top bill?
